title: Personalized Sinhala Speech Recognition for Speech-Impaired Communication
content: Building a speech-recognition system for Sinhala-speaking individuals with speech impairments such as dysarthria, personalized to each user's own voice and trained on 40 everyday phrases covering food, pain, help, and emergencies.

title: Multi-Agent Frameworks for Social Media Virality Modeling and Algorithm Behavior Reverse Engineering
content: Unifying how content spreads on social media with how platform recommendation algorithms actually behave, using an LLM-based multi-agent simulation framework to reverse engineer platform behavior.

title: Multi-Agent Pipeline for Research to Product Software Automation
content: Automating the path from a written problem statement to a tested implementation through four gated multi-agent stages — Research, Architecture, Development, and Testing — with verified evidence and full audit trails.

title: Formally-Constrained Self-Evolution for Multi-Agent Systems via Verified Memory Containment and Causal Safety Verification
content: Building self-evolving enterprise multi-agent architectures that remain formally safe as they improve, with formally verified automaton changes, full skill-lineage quarantine, and automatic rollback.

title: StressSense: Detecting Stress and Depression from Smartphone Usage Patterns
content: Investigating whether smartphone usage patterns — screen time, app usage, sleep, movement, and social interaction — can reveal signs of stress, anxiety, or depression using simple, explainable machine learning models.

title: GraspNet – 6-DoF Grasp Pose Estimation
content: Exploring 6-DoF grasp pose estimation using the GraspNet-1Billion benchmark to improve grasp detection accuracy and robustness for robotic manipulation in complex, cluttered environments.
